⚠ ${e}
`).join(''); const issueChips = rev.issues.map(e => `
🔍 ${e}
`).join(''); const body = `
📋
Proposal Awaiting Review
First-pass check flagged something
Lead
${ctx.lead_email}
${gErrors.length ? `
Guardrail Errors

values.content:
=You extract structured sales-call requirements. Do not add anything the lead did not say.

CALL SUMMARY:
{{ $json.overview }}

TOPICS DISCUSSED:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.topics_discussed) }}

FULL TRANSCRIPT:
{{ $json.transcript_text.slice(0, 12000) }}

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no preamble:
{
  "budget_signal": "explicit number, range, or null if not mentioned",
  "timeline": "what the lead said about urgency/timeline, or null",
  "key_requirements": ["specific things the lead asked for"],
  "pain_points": ["problems the lead described"],
  "objections_raised": ["concerns or pushback from the lead"],
  "competitors_mentioned": ["any competitor names mentioned"],
  "decision_makers": ["names/roles mentioned as involved in the decision"]
}
